facts.fact: The Minister of Post and Telecommunications described law 15-04 of 1 February 2015 on general rules for electronic signature and certification as the text currently in force, covering certification and electronic signatures only; the document is dated 2025-12-01 (month proxy) and gives no other date for this.
facts.system: Loi 15-04 du 1er février 2015 fixant les règles générales relatives à la signature et à la certification électroniques

facts.fact: A draft law fixing general rules on trust services for electronic transactions and electronic identification, which would replace law 15-04, was presented to the National People's Assembly (APN) by the Minister, following Council of Ministers approval on 2 November 2025; it recognises electronic contracts and electronic documents as equal to paper, creates the ANCE authority and sets sanctions.
facts.system: Projet de loi fixant les règles générales relatives aux services de confiance pour les transactions électroniques et à l'identification électronique
